name: Codex home
responsibility: Each host supplies private state. Archboard servers share the Archboard home, and the example uses its own state root.
description: An archboard-only CODEX_HOME under the state directory, readable by nobody else. One sign-in serves every server, since Codex takes several processes on one home; what a server keeps about its own child, the owner lock and the epoch ledger, sits under its port. The server fills in the config it needs (auto-review approvals, a sandbox with network access) and keeps what Codex or the user set.
